semantics: Bolt scopes distinguish recessed pockets and raised fittings. All lining departures selects supported points on both sides of the tolerance band without a bolt-size or compactness filter; reviewed groups can be removed or separated with one-step Undo. Whole cloud streams all retained IDs in bounded lining windows and local scope retains its neighbourhood working budget. Active limit boxes still apply. Area restoration tests full-density original IDs in project coordinates and leaves unselected deleted points in persisted binary remainder lists. Normal groups restore in place; cleaning archives restore as separate scans. Mixed groups commit together and support one-step Undo. Deleted-area export uses original-density source observations, optionally with source wall context, without restoring them. The supplied E57 crop was checked against the actual local classifier. The 0.21.2 independent-bundle fix is retained.
preserved_outputs: Registered XYZ/attributes, independent cleaned XYZ/mask, saved mesh, analysis and inspection survive source-bundle deletion and named project reopening in the regression.
recovery_limit: Pre-existing permanently removed caches cannot be recreated by this patch.
